title: santaiaja.com
heading: Designing and building a single-page luxury fashion drop site
summary: SANTAI is a luxury fashion label built around a seasonal drop model — one exclusive shirt released per season. I designed and built the entire site as a single immersive page, with a password-protected CMS built in, so the brand can launch new drops and update pricing, images, and sizing without touching code. Here's how it came together.
challenge: A single-shirt drop needs to feel like an event, not a product page. The brief was to make one shirt feel worth the wait — full-screen presentation, real texture and detail, sound, motion — and since there's a new drop every season, it also had to run without a developer in the loop. Updating stock, images, or copy couldn't mean opening a code editor.

sections.body: Built as a single HTML file backed by Supabase for data and storage: a full-screen shirt display with 360° drag-to-rotate and front/back swap, a hold-to-reveal detail panel with looping audio, swipe navigation between drops, and a password-protected CMS covering everything from the logo and background to each article's copy, images, and availability. Client-side image compression and localStorage caching keep it fast without a heavy stack.
